prompt:
You are a senior financial analyst in the Finance & Planning division at Bank of America. The Controller has asked you to prepare a quarterly variance analysis for the most recent quarter (Q1 2026) versus the prior quarter (Q4 2025, which can be derived from FY 2025 full-year less Q3 2025 YTD figures). This analysis will be presented at the quarterly business review and will inform capital allocation discussions with the CFO.

Materials provided:
- The attached Excel file 'BAC_Financial_Data.xlsx' containing XBRL-sourced quarterly and full-year financial data for Bank of America Corp (CIK 0000070858) covering revenue, net income, total assets, total liabilities, stockholders' equity, and diluted EPS.

Task requirements:
1. Create a variance analysis workbook with three sheets: 'Inputs', 'Q1 2026 Variances', and 'Ratios'.
2. On the 'Inputs' sheet, enter all provided financial figures for Q1 2026, FY 2025, Q3 2025 (both cumulative YTD and quarterly), and Q2 2025. Label each metric and period clearly.
3. Derive Q4 2025 figures by subtracting Q3 2025 YTD (cumulative) values from FY 2025 full-year values for each metric. Show this calculation explicitly on the Inputs sheet.
4. On the 'Q1 2026 Variances' sheet, compute for each metric: (a) Q1 2026 value, (b) derived Q4 2025 value, (c) absolute variance (Q1 2026 minus Q4 2025), and (d) percentage variance ((Q1 2026 - Q4 2025) / Q4 2025).
5. On the 'Ratios' sheet, calculate the following for Q1 2026 only: net profit margin (net income / revenue), asset turnover (revenue / total assets), equity multiplier (total assets / stockholders' equity), and return on equity using DuPont decomposition (net profit margin x asset turnover x equity multiplier).
6. Format all dollar amounts with comma separators and no decimal places. Format percentages to two decimal places. Format EPS to two decimal places.
7. Use Excel formulas for all calculated cells; do not hard-code derived values.

Deliverable specification:
Submit a single Excel workbook (.xlsx) named 'BAC_Q1_2026_Variance_Analysis.xlsx' containing three sheets as described above.
